notes: Only compound named in the section. 环磺酮 is the standard Chinese common name for tembotrione, so the resolution is unambiguous; the Chinese is kept as an alias. The EN line renders it as "tembotrione (huanhuangtong)", a pinyin gloss rather than a conflicting name. 有机化工技术领域 (field of organic chemical technology) is a field-of-art term, not a compound, so it is not extracted. is_section_product is true because the section states the invention is a process for preparing this compound and names no other.
